basic_details.job_title: RIMS Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level 10 - Rs. 56,100 as per 7th CPC

how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form from the Office of the Principal, Dental College, RIMS, Imphal.
Enclose self-attested copies of BDS mark sheets, Attempt, Internship, Age proof, Provisional Pass Certificate and Dental Council Registration.
Submit the form on or before 23-11-2026 (4:00 PM).
Applicants called appear before the Selection Board on 27-11-2026 at 11:00 AM.
important_instructions: Authority reserves the right to appoint Junior Residents in departments as per the need of the hospital Incomplete form shall be rejected Copies of documents must be self-attested

content_sections.text: Shortlisting of 3 times the number of vacancies based on percentage of I, II, III, IV year marks for Dentistry Interview before the Selection Board Only 3 times the number of vacancies called for interview based on percentage of I, II, III, IV year marks for Dentistry Interview before Selection Board at Conference Room of Principal's Office, Dental College, 27-11-2026, 11:00 AM Time slot for respective departments to be informed in due course

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RIMS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from the Office of the Principal, Dental College, RIMS, Imphal. Enclose self-attested copies of BDS mark sheets, Attempt, Internship, Age proof, Provisional Pass Certificate and Dental Council Registration. Submit the form on or before 23-11-2026 (4:00 PM). Applicants called appear before the Selection Board on 27-11-2026 at 11:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Authority reserves the right to appoint Junior Residents in departments as per the need of the hospital Incomplete form shall be rejected Copies of documents must be self-attested

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies for Junior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Office of the Principal, Dental College, RIMS, Imphal; form format printed on page 2 of the notice) and send it to Office of the Principal, Dental College, RIMS, Imphal, Manipur, by by hand, to reach by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level 10 - Rs. 56,100 as per 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Dental Graduates (BDS).

faq.question: Q6. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed 2 years of Junior Residency.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of 3 times the number of vacancies based on percentage of I, II, III, IV year marks for Dentistry. Interview before the Selection Board. Only 3 times the number of vacancies called for interview based on percentage of I, II, III, IV year marks for Dentistry. Interview before Selection Board at Conference Room of Principal's Office, Dental College, 27-11-2026, 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment for 6 (six) months w.e.f. 01-12-2026. No private practice allowed for selected candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by RIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Dental College, RIMS, Imphal, Tobacco Cessation Centre (third candidate in merit list), Peripheral Centre (fourth candidate in merit list).

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Mark sheets (BDS); Attempt Certificate; Internship Certificate; Age proof Certificate; Provisional Pass Certificate and Dental Council Registration.
